FRONTEND Playwright PASS: login as demo.provider; Dashboard Galería with pro+no-video shows video-upload-allowed + video-upload-trigger (no locked); after API upload+reload shows video-preview with video-replace-btn + video-remove-btn; switch to free shows video-upload-locked with video-upgrade-cta href='/plans' (no allowed); gallery-category-select-g_seed1 select 'negocio' persists via /providers/me; public eCard with video shows ecard-video + ecard-video-player ABOVE ecard-gallery (DOM order verified); with 2 photos tagged → ecard-gallery-grid-filters renders with -filter-all + -filter-trabajo_terminado + -filter-equipo, clicking trabajo_terminado reduces visible thumbs (3→1), 'Todas' restores; lightbox caption contains chip 'Trabajo terminado'; with no video + no categories, ecard-video and ecard-gallery-grid-filters do NOT render.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3917 lines — single-file monolith continues to grow (Sprint B adds ~50 lines without modularization). Consider splitting providers/gallery/video into its own router module.

MAX_VIDEO_SIZE check uses len(data) after full file.read() — a 200MB upload buffers the whole payload in RAM; not safe under concurrency. Consider streaming + size check on chunks (e.g., via UploadFile.spool_max_size and incremental read) or rejecting based on Content-Length header before reading.

ALLOWED_VIDEO_TYPES is checked against the client-supplied Content-Type header only. A malicious client can claim 'video/mp4' while uploading any binary (including HTML/JS). For a public eCard serving these via <video src>, this becomes a potential XSS/abuse vector. Recommend magic-byte sniffing (e.g., python-magic) and forcing Content-Disposition + Content-Type on the served file.

Both PHOTO_CATEGORY_LABELS in backend (server.py) and CATEGORY_LABELS in frontend (GalleryGrid.jsx + DashboardGallery.jsx) duplicate the same key→label mapping in 3 places — drift risk. Backend should be the single source of truth (frontend should fetch from /api/gallery/photo-categories which already exists). Note: frontend uses 'Herramientas' but backend returns 'Mis herramientas'; 'Mi negocio' vs 'Mi negocio / local'. Inconsistent labels for the same key.

DELETE /providers/me/video returns 200 even if the provider had no video set (no idempotency guard — could mask broken UI), and it does not delete the underlying blob in storage (orphan file in db.files). Recommend also marking the file record is_deleted=true.
POST /providers/me/video does not delete the previously uploaded video's storage blob when replacing — orphan files accumulate.
video_url field is stored as plain path; provider_profiles document lacks any Pydantic model — no schema enforcement at the boundary.

Frontend ProviderVideoUpload checks plan via prop only — if the client manipulates plan locally the locked UI can be bypassed, but the backend will still 403; non-blocking, just defense-in-depth note.

Milestone gamification modals interrupt automated UI testing (and likely user flows) immediately on dashboard re-entry — confirmed twice during this iteration. They should expose a stable data-testid AND/OR not auto-display on routine page loads if user already acknowledged.
